cues: Crosstalk: you faintly hear another call.
Jitter: packets arriving unevenly, which ruins a video call.
And bandwidth itself is a limit: a channel simply cannot carry changes faster than its bandwidth.
text: More impairments. Crosstalk: you faintly hear another call. Echo: you hear yourself, delayed. Jitter: packets arriving unevenly, which ruins a video call. And bandwidth itself is a limit: a channel simply cannot carry changes faster than its bandwidth.
